title: Berkeley DB signature
summary: A Berkeley DB file begins with the 4-byte magic 0x00061561 (little-endian: 61 15 06 00) for Btree, or 0x00053162 for Hash, or 0x00042253 for Queue, or 0x00040988 for Recno.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Berkeley DB is an embedded key-value database.
Used by many applications (RPM, Postfix, etc.).
